args: Product photos go to the S3 bucket harvest-media, never the app server.
Prices are stored in cents as integers.
Farmer payouts run through Stripe Connect in app/payouts.py.
Listings expire after 14 days unless renewed.
Dates in API responses use ISO 8601 with a timezone offset.

steps.final: Payout fees in app/payouts.py round half up to the cent now. 31 passed.
